ECMAScript 3 (1999)
The first revision to JavaScript.
ECMAScript 1999 is also known as ES3.
ES3 Features

rows: Sequence of characters that forms a search pattern
Statement to define code blocks to be tested in case of an error
Selects code blocks to be executed based on a conditions
A variant of the while loop
